evals.prompt: I'm building the landing page for Shipwise, a shipment tracking SaaS. I want a hero illustration at the top: a little 3D warehouse yard with trucks arriving and forklifts moving pallets, animated, that reacts a bit to the mouse. Our brand colour is #5b4ae0. Give me one HTML file I can open and later embed in Next.js.
evals.expected_output: One self-contained diorama-<name>.html built with the kit: a hero-size scene on a rounded base with a building, docks, racks, a road loop inside the base, a truck on a lap that stops at a dock with a door that opens, a forklift shuttle, trees and lamps; three or more loops of different periods; the pointer tilts the camera and has one answer (a lift or a light). Brand colour passed through palette, not new hex literals. look.mjs ran, the sheet was read, console clean. The hand-over names the concept, the still second, and points to references/react.md for Next.js.

evals.prompt: need an empty state illustration for our inbox screen when there are no messages. something small, 3d, cute, isometric, with a tiny bit of animation. white card background. just an html file is fine
evals.expected_output: A mini-size diorama: one object that would hold mail (a letterbox, a tray, a pigeonhole) shown empty on a small base with one or two neighbours, transparent canvas over the white card, one ambient motion with a long period and a short active part, no words inside the scene, an empty: { title, body, action } on the figure. Under 150 lines, no D.label. Reads at 160px. look.mjs ran and the thumbnail was judged.

evals.prompt: For our docs page on how the build queue works, make a card-sized 3D illustration: jobs wait in line, one runner picks them up one at a time. It should loop forever and do something when you hover it.
evals.expected_output: A card-size diorama of a place (a conveyor, a loading bay, a counter) where items queue and one agent takes them one at a time on a schedule of legs with pauses; parts.hot set and a sprung pointer answer (lift, light or a move toward the hovered item); a title and a means that explain the process; at most one label; base, soft shadows, two or three accents. look.mjs ran, sheet read, exit 0.

evals.prompt: Our site is very minimal, black text on white, no colour except our purple #5b4ae0 for links. I want a small 3D illustration for the 'no results' state of the search page, in a line-drawing style like those hairline figures, nothing cartoony or colourful. One HTML file please.
evals.expected_output: A mini-size diorama declared with theme 'line' (or { base: 'line', accent: '#5b4ae0' }): white fills, ink edges and silhouettes, no shadows, the accent only on the one thing the eye should find (a loupe over a blank sheet, a bare sieve, an empty tray); no new hex literals beyond the accent; cylinders with 12+ segments so no seams show; one quiet ambient motion; empty: { title, body, action } set. look.mjs ran in the line theme and the thumbnail was judged at 160px.
